about: Round RPG4: the region and its towns. PLACEHOLDERS: the names, colours and set lists are Claude's, for the game logic to run on; Karl names them when the region's content is written. A town's shop sells singles from its region's tier band (tiers, inclusive) leaning to its colours, and booster packs of its sets (only sets with a pack pool in rpg/data/packs/). An enemy's reward cards come from the same band. Round RPG9: enemy_decks says which of an enemy kind's deck lists a fight uses, by kind of encounter: jumpstart (three Jumpstart half-decks, like a starting deck, with its strongest spells swapped for basic lands - rpg/data/balance.json) or archetype (Forge's Pauper archetype decks) - on region 1 the map's regular foes play Jumpstart decks, the cave's dungeon foes and its boss archetype ones (Karl, 14 Oct 2026: Jumpstart foes first). Round RPG12 (23 Oct 2026): region 1 and its towns take the names of the story draft (claude/SPEC_RPG_SLICE_2026-10-23.md, claude/RPG_STORY_DRAFT_2026-10-23.md) - still Claude's placeholders for Karl to rename; the ids stay, so saves are unchanged. Round PACK1 (3 Nov 2026): two more sets per town (Lantern Hollow 8ED, 10E; Brackwater 9ED, 6ED; Cinder Gate FDN, 7ED - the gentlest in the first town; claude/PACK1_2026-11-03.md section 2).
